site.name: Homemade Arcade
site.tagline: Every game here was built by one kid, one idea at a time. Pick one and press play.

games.title: 贪吃蛇
games.description: Classic snake — eat food to grow, dodge walls and obstacles. Speed increases as you score.

games.title: 霓虹闯关
games.description: A neon cyberpunk side-scrolling platformer — 12 levels of running, jumping, and shooting through glowing enemies. Double-jump, dodge spikes, and blast your way to the exit.

games.title: 火箭消灭怪物
games.description: Pilot your rocket and blast waves of alien invaders...

games.title: 植物大战僵尸
games.description: Plants vs. Zombies-style tower defense — plant sunflowers to generate sun, defend your lawn across 10 waves of increasingly tough zombies. Five plant types, four zombie types.
